QuestInfo.name: Bluffing Tom's Mama
QuestInfo.0: Bluffing Tom's got one final request.
QuestInfo.1: Save Bluffing #p9390315# somewhere in the Kobold's Cave.
QuestInfo.2: You saved Bluffing #p9390315#! Look at you go!

2.msg: My instincts tell me that my mom is somewhere at the deepest end of Kobold Cave!\nCan you please, pretty please go find my mom in there? ...With a cherry on top?

3.msg: (Tom sounds like he's telling the truth. You should help him out.)

yes.0: Whew, I knew I could count on you.

npc.0: Please, go to the very end! That's where my mom'll be! You have to save her!
